context_mapping_policy.primary_basis: Canonical evidence key resolution matching candidate.evidence_refs
context_mapping_policy.fallback_behavior: When no direct context match exists, analyst accesses task-scoped review queue directly without false context association.

epistemic_integrity.fact_handling: FACT assertions verified against grounded evidence
epistemic_integrity.hypothesis_handling: HYPOTHESIS assertions prominently tagged with warning: 'This is a hypothesis, not a verified fact.' Acceptance preserves HYPOTHESIS epistemic class.
